name: Kouhei's father
source:
Kouhei's father, who passed away when Kouhei was young.

[spoiler]In the "Mother and Father" route, he was in an affair with [url=/c135968]Naomi's mother[/url]. In that same route, Kouhei's physical appearance transforms into his father, and suffers the wrath of Naomi's mother's revenge.[/spoiler]
